# stb_image

Public-domain decoder / encoder from [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb) (`stb_image.h`, `stb_image_write.h`).

`stb_image.h` copied from the ImGuizmo example already in **rigImGui** (`third_party/ImGuizmo/example/stb_image.h`, v2.16). `stb_image_write.h` (v1.16) copied from **rigPixelPlotter** (`third_party/stb/stb_image_write.h`).
